dn5:11.2: ‘bhoto kho rañño janapado sakaṇṭako sauppīḷo. gāmaghātā’pi dissanti, nigamaghātā’pi dissanti, nagaraghātāpi dissanti, panthadūhanā’pi dissanti.
dn5:11.3: bhavaṃ ce kho pana rājā evaṃ sakaṇṭake janapade sauppīḷe balimuddhareyya, akiccakārī assa tena bhavaṃ rājā.

dn5:11.5: ‘ahametaṃ dassukhīlaṃ vadhena vā bandhena vā jāniyā vā garahāya vā pabbājanāya vā samūhanissāmī’ti. na kho panetassa dassukhīlassa evaṃ sammā samugghāto hoti.
dn5:11.6: ye te hatāvasesakā bhavissanti, te pacchā rañño janapadaṃ viheṭhessanti.
dn5:11.7: api ca kho idaṃ saṃvidhānaṃ āgamma evametassa dassukhīlassa sammā samugghāto hoti.

dn5:21.3: kūṭadanto pana brāhmaṇo tuṇhībhūto’va nisinno hoti.

dn5:29.6: evamevaṃ kūṭadantassa brāhmaṇassa tasmiṃ yeva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi:
dn5:30.1: atha kho kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo diṭṭhadhammo pattadhammo viditadhammo pariyogāḷhadhammo tiṇṇavicikiccho vigatakathaṃkatho vesārajjappatto aparappaccayo satthusāsane bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
dn5:30.2: adhivāsetu me bhavaṃ gotamo svātanāya bhattaṃ saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghenāti.
dn5:30.4: atha kho kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo bhagavato adhivāsanaṃ viditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
dn5:30.5: atha kho kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo tassā rattiyā accayena sake yaññāvāṭe paṇītaṃ khādanīyaṃ bhojanīyaṃ paṭiyādāpetvā bhagavato kālaṃ ārocāpesi:
dn5:30.7: atha kho bhagavā pubbanhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya saddhiṃ bhikkhusaṅghena yena kūṭadantassa brāhmaṇassa yaññāvāṭo tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
dn5:30.8: atha kho kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo buddhapamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi.
dn5:30.9: atha kho kūṭadanto brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ aññataraṃ nīcaṃ āsanaṃ gahetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
dn5:30.10: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho kūṭadantaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmīti.
